1. `isDataValid` checks that `dataLen >= be32toh(lenOptions)` - meaning the total options length field must be <= dataLen. But it doesn't validate individual option lengths.

2. In `getOptions()`, the code reads `hdr->type` and `hdr->length` from the option header. The `optionLen = be16toh(hdr->length) + 3`. If the option's `length` field claims a value larger than what's actually available in the buffer, the loop will advance `offset` beyond the buffer.

3. When `SomeIpSdIPv6Option::getIpAddress()` is called, it reads 16 bytes from `hdr->ipv6Address` via `IPv6Address ipAddr(hdr->ipv6Address)`, which does `memcpy(m_Bytes, bytes, 16)`. If the option data is truncated (e.g., the option claims to be 19+ bytes but only a few bytes are actually in the buffer), this reads beyond the heap buffer.

The key insight: The `length` field in the option header is attacker-controlled. If we set it to a large value, `getOptions()` will advance `offset` past the actual data. Then when `getIpAddress()` is called on the `SomeIpSdIPv6Option`, it reads 16 bytes from a location that's beyond the heap buffer.

CMakeLists.txt  DumpToFile.h  FuzzTarget.cpp  FuzzWriter.cpp  README.md  ReadParsedPacket.h  RegressionTests  default.options  ossfuzz.sh
TARGETS_DIR=build/

# Build libpcap
cd $SRC/libpcap/
./autogen.sh
./configure --enable-shared=no
make -j$(nproc)

# Build PcapPlusPlus linking statically against the built libpcap
cd $SRC/PcapPlusPlus
LIBPCAP_PATH=$SRC/libpcap/
cmake -DPCAPPP_BUILD_FUZZERS=ON -DPCAPPP_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DPCAPPP_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DPCAP_INCLUDE_DIR="${LIBPCAP_PATH}/" -DPCAP_LIBRARY="${LIBPCAP_PATH}/libpcap.a" -S . -B $TARGETS_DIR
cmake --build $TARGETS_DIR -j

# Copy target and options
FUZZERS="
    FuzzTarget \
    FuzzTargetNg \
    FuzzTargetSnoop \
    FuzzWriter \
    FuzzWriterNg"

for fuzzer in $FUZZERS; do
    cp $TARGETS_DIR/Tests/Fuzzers/${fuzzer} $OUT
    cp $(ldd $OUT/${fuzzer} | cut -d" " -f3) $OUT
    cp Tests/Fuzzers/default.options $OUT/${fuzzer}.options
done

# Copy corpora
find $SRC/ -iname "*.pcap"   | xargs zip $OUT/FuzzTarget_seed_corpus.zip
find $SRC/ -iname "*.pcapng" | xargs zip $OUT/FuzzTargetNg_seed_corpus.zip
find $SRC/ -iname "*.snoop"  | xargs zip $OUT/FuzzTargetSnoop_seed_corpus.zip
find $SRC/ -iname "*.pcap"   | xargs zip $OUT/FuzzWriter_seed_corpus.zip
find $SRC/ -iname "*.pcapng" | xargs zip $OUT/FuzzWriterNg_seed_corpus.zip
